title: Prefix and suffix passes — everything except me
summary: Answer "combine everything to my left with everything to my right" with one left-to-right pass and one right-to-left pass, without division.

sections.title: Idea
sections.body:
✍️ For each index i, the answer combines `left[i]` (all elements before i) and `right[i]` (all elements after i).
✍️ A forward pass fills `left`, a backward pass fills `right`, and the answer is `left[i] ⊕ right[i]` for whatever operation ⊕ is (sum, product, max).
✍️ To get O(1) extra space, write `left` directly into the output array, then sweep backwards with a single running `right` variable.

sections.title: Recognise it
sections.body: ✍️ "product of all elements except itself", "without using division", "trapping water" (max to the left and right), "candies with neighbours", "left max / right max".

sections.title: Template: product except self in O(1) extra space
Why not just divide?
sections.body: ✍️ total / a[i] breaks when a[i] = 0 (and with one zero, every other answer is 0; with two zeros, all answers are 0). The prefix/suffix method handles zeros with no special cases.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.body: O(n) time, O(1) extra space besides the output.
